overview.description: The AB Core Plus Bond ETF (CPLS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in USD-denominated corporate and government debt securities of any maturity and credit quality. The fund uses a bottom-up, quantitative process to select securities. CPLS was launched on Dec 13, 2023 and is issued by AB Funds.
